name: Marathon Petroleum Corporation
research_rationale: Filed Q3 2026 EBITDA, buybacks and dividend lift support cash cover behind the screen buy; force majeure on ND crude and TTM–filed FCF gaps still cap conviction on cyclical leverage.

weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 2026 results release (3 Nov): $11.7bn adjusted EBITDA, 10% dividend increase, $3.3bn capital returned; divestiture intent signalled in the filing excerpt.  
Headlines cite force majeure on North Dakota oil deliveries (19 Nov); scope and duration are not detailed in the supplied sources.  
Share moved on multi-day declines and insider-selling coverage; refreshed library data does not change filed FY2025 leverage or pension themes.
